motor.paso.reparto.ayuda: Tap the card to see it. Do not let anyone else see it. When you have read it, press “Ready”.
motor.paso.comediante.titulo: Which character do you play tonight?
motor.paso.comediante.ayuda: You will use their power tonight and the card is discarded. You can save them for another night.
motor.paso.cupido.ayuda: You may choose yourself. If one dies, the other dies of grief.
motor.cronica.cupido: The Archer ({nombre}) made {a} and {b} fall in love.
motor.paso.enamorados.texto: The Archer has joined you with {nombre}. If one dies, the other dies of grief. You can never vote against your partner.
motor.paso.juez.texto: Once per game, during a vote, you may secretly press “Second vote”. After that vote there will be another one immediately, with no debate. Nobody else sees that button.
motor.paso.hermanos.reconocelos: Open your eyes and recognise them: {nombres}.
motor.paso.hermanos.ya_no: Your siblings are no longer here.
motor.paso.nino_salvaje.ayuda: If your mentor dies, you will become a Werewolf. As long as they live, you are just another villager.
motor.cronica.nino_salvaje_modelo: The Wild Child ({nombre}) chose {modelo} as their mentor.
motor.paso.domador.texto: Every morning, if any of your neighbours is a Werewolf, the bear will growl. Your neighbours now are: {vecinos}.
motor.paso.vidente.titulo: Whose card do you want to discover?

motor.cronica.zorro_no: The Fox ({nombre}) sniffed {grupo}: there was no wolf.

motor.paso.zorro.resultado_no: 🦊 No: among {grupo} there is no wolf. You lose your sense of smell.
motor.paso.protector.ayuda: You may protect yourself, but not the same person two nights in a row.
motor.paso.perro_lobo.ayuda: Choose forever: Villager or Werewolf. If you choose wolf, you wake up with the pack from tonight.
motor.cronica.perro_lobo: The Dual Nature ({nombre}) chose to be a Werewolf.
motor.cronica.perro_aldeano: The Dual Nature ({nombre}) chose to be a Villager.
motor.cronica.nina: The Quiet Spy ({nombre}) spied and saw {lobo}.
motor.cronica.nina_pillada: The Quiet Spy ({nombre}) spied and saw {lobo}, but was caught.
motor.paso.lobos.nina_ayuda: You can spy: you will see one of the wolves. But if you are caught ({riesgo}% risk), you will die tonight instead of their victim.
motor.paso.lobos.ayuda: You must all choose the same person. If you do not agree, nobody dies.
motor.paso.albino.ayuda: Tonight you wake up alone. You can kill a Werewolf… or do nothing.
motor.paso.infecto.sin_victima_texto: Tonight there is no victim to infect.
motor.paso.infecto.ayuda: Only once per game. {nombre} will not die: they will secretly become a Werewolf and keep their power.
motor.paso.feroz.ayuda: As long as no wolf has fallen, you can hunt a second victim on your own.
motor.paso.bruja.titulo: Alchemist, do you use your potions?

motor.paso.flautista.ayuda: You win as soon as all the living are enchanted.
motor.paso.hechizados.texto: The Shadow Piper has enchanted you. The enchanted are: {lista}.
motor.paso.piromano.ayuda: You can use your power once per game. If the Werewolves attack that person tonight, they are saved and the nearest wolf on their right dies.
motor.paso.cuervo.titulo: 🦅 Raven's Omen, choose someone to curse
motor.paso.cuervo.ayuda: The person you choose will start the next day's vote with 2 votes against them.
motor.paso.alguacil.ayuda: Their vote will count double. You may vote for yourself.
motor.paso.debate.ayuda: Discuss out loud. When you are clear, ask to move on to the vote.
motor.paso.votacion.titulo: Whom do you want to lynch?
motor.paso.votacion.ayuda: The votes are all revealed at the same time at the end.
motor.paso.votacion.ayuda_alguacil: The votes are all revealed at the same time at the end. You are the Sheriff: your vote counts double.
motor.cronica.juez: The Judge ({nombre}) asked for a second vote.
motor.paso.sirvienta.ayuda: If you sacrifice yourself, you will reveal that you are the Handmaiden and secretly take {nombre}'s card, with their powers.
motor.cronica.sirvienta: The Handmaiden ({nombre}) took the place of {victima} and took their card ({rol}).
motor.paso.cazador.ayuda: You are the Hunter. Choose who takes your last shot.
motor.paso.sucesor.ayuda: With your last breath, choose who inherits your office (their vote will count double).
motor.paso.chivo.titulo: Who will be allowed to vote in the next vote?
motor.paso.chivo.ayuda: Mark those who will be allowed to vote. If you do not choose anyone in time, everyone will vote.
ui.nivel.sencillo.texto: Few powers, easy to explain. Ideal for the first game.
ui.nivel.equilibrado.texto: A good mix of powers. The recommended starting point.
ui.nivel.avanzado.texto: Lots of powers, hidden sides and unexpected twists. For people who have played before.
